subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_diode_bias_generator ib_sink vdd
M6 ib_sink ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_diode_bias_generator
subcircuits.role_hint: Bias generation network using diode-connected PMOS M6. The node ib_sink is an AC-stiff PMOS gate-bias voltage generated from the external bias current path through M6 and used to bias the PMOS current source M5 in the amplifier core.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt complementary_input_single_ended_ota_core gnd ib_sink vdd vin vip vo
M2 net1 net2 gnd gnd nch l=ln_tail w=wn_tail m=1 nf=1
M1 vo vin net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M0 net2 vip net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M5 net3 ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
M4 vo vin net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
M3 net2 vip net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
.ends complementary_input_single_ended_ota_core
subcircuits.role_hint: Main complementary-input single-ended OTA signal path. NMOS input devices M1/M0 and PMOS input devices M4/M3 share differential input gates vin/vip. The single-ended output is vo. M5 receives the PMOS bias voltage ib_sink from the bias generator. M2 is an internally controlled NMOS tail/current-control device driven by net2, which is part of the amplifier conduction-linked signal path.
